result_summary.title: SSO Notifications failing - likely third-party outage
result_summary.description: We are noticing that notifications are not being delivered through our SSO Integration Module in production (EU-Central). We believe this is definitely a third-party service failure on their end, as we haven't changed anything on our side. The upstream timeout seems to be caused by their service being down. Please escalate to the vendor as we think their API is unresponsive.
